description: Trigger a new scan of a single page on a domain available to this key. The domain must already be tracked in benchmarq (onboard it at app-benchmarq first) -- new, never-before-tracked domains are rejected; call get_tracked_domains (or read the benchmarq://domains resource, if this client supports resources) to see which domains are available before calling this. Scans triggered here never elevate past the account's default scan tier, so only static checks actually run -- app (ARO) and ecom (ACO) pillars will be null on a scan started this way, regardless of the account plan. The scan's own reported "profile" field may still say "all" (that reflects what was requested/defaulted, not what actually ran) -- app/ecom not running is expected, not a sign something went wrong. Consumes one scan credit. Returns a jobId immediately; use get_scan_status to check progress, then get_page_scores, get_page_issues, or get_page_report once it completes -- the jobId alone is enough for all of those, now or later, no other credential needed. A page scan usually finishes within 120 seconds -- wait at least 15 seconds before the first get_scan_status call, and space subsequent calls at least 15-20 seconds apart rather than polling continuously.
name: trigger_page_scan
title: Trigger page scan
